card.name: Opening pieces of drug names
card.fires_on: Short pieces at the start or middle of a drug or brand name, such as Chi, NSA, EB, Angeli, and the ine ending of carbamazepine-type names. It often follows a heading or list break in label text.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: First piece of a brand name that opens a sentence right after a section heading.
modes.example: Preparation of Recommended Dosage<< Chi>>RhoStim ® is a ly

modes.label: NSAID split
modes.description: The NSA piece of the class name NSAIDs after a bullet or heading.
modes.example: •<< NSA>>IDs cause an increased risk of serious cardiovascular

modes.label: Ending of -epine names
modes.description: The ine piece completing names like carbamazepine or oxcarbazepine.

card.plain: It fires inside drug names that are split into pieces, especially at the first piece of a brand name or class name.
